About This application is created for listening to Internet radio stations. Therefor we use database https://www.radio-browser.info/ that contains information about Internet radio stations all over the world. Just click on the place on the map you are insterested in, chose radiostation from the list and enjoy! The app also uses images from pixabay.com and country coordinates from https://developers.google.com/public-data/ (sep. 2023). Country names are taken from external sources and may not correspond to modern realities. The application is totally free and without ads. Therefore, I will be pleased if you support me: Save to Google Drive Restore from Google Drive Save to local storage Restore from local storage Mail for your feedbacks gartel.av@gmail.com Support the project (Boosty) The app uses images from pixabay.com
My stations My stations Stations you add yourself - for example, a local radio that is missing from the catalogue. Add a link to its stream and it will appear here. The list is empty. Tap + to add a station by its stream link. Add a station Station added Changes saved Edit the station Station deleted Delete the station? %1$s will be removed from your list. The station itself stays available - you can add it again by the same link. Delete Cancel New station Edit the station Station name Link to the stream The link usually ends with .mp3, .aac or .m3u8 and can be found on the station\'s website Save Cancel Enter a name - this is how the station will be shown in the list The link must start with http:// or https:// A station with this link is already in your list

!-- permissions: why the app asks for them (shown before the system dialog) --> Continue Not now OK Settings Why we need your location The map opens on the country you are in, so you can find nearby radio stations right away. The location is used on your phone only: it is not saved and not sent anywhere. You can use the app without it - just move the map by hand. The map will open on the world view instead of your country. Everything else works as usual. Why we need notifications The notification shows the station you are listening to and the play and pause buttons, so you can control the radio without opening the app. Nothing else is sent to you. The radio will play, but there will be no notification with the play and pause buttons.
